name: divide-and-conquer-dev-plugin
description: Autonomous Divide-and-Conquer multi-agent engineering & domain delivery plugin for OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Antigravity, and Claude Code. Transforms monolithic specifications into parallel Modules, User Stories, and non-blocking Implementation Units inside isolated Git worktrees across 8 industry --field presets.

interface.shortDescription: Decompose monolithic specs into parallel Git worktree units with multi-council review and 283 specialist agents.
interface.longDescription: Transforms monolithic specifications into bounded Modules, User Stories, and dynamically sized non-blocking Implementation Units in isolated Git worktrees, governed by multi-council code review, mandatory patch-implementer remediation loops, GitHub Projects Kanban tracking, and 8 industry --field presets.
